title: VIP Chapter 1 Week 1: Introduction to Geography

questions.text: If Ethiopia is at 8°N and 38°E, what does 38°E represent?
questions.explanation: 38°E is LONGITUDE (east-west position). Latitude is north-south (8°N). Altitude is height above sea level. Depth is below surface.

questions.text: Ethiopia's tropical location means it receives:
questions.explanation: Tropical location (near equator) means the sun is overhead most of the year, giving warm temperatures.

questions.text: Which theme of Geography studies how people ADAPT to their environment?
questions.explanation: Human-Environment Interaction covers how humans adapt, modify, and depend on environment.

questions.text: Ethiopia is the ______ largest country in Africa.
questions.explanation: Ethiopia is the 10th largest African country by area (~1.1 million km²).

questions.text: The Horn of Africa is located in which part of Africa?
questions.explanation: The Horn is the EASTERNMOST projection of the African continent.
Geography = Geo (Earth) + Graphia (Description).
Ethiopia spans 33°E to 48°E LONGITUDE (east-west). 3°N-15°N is LATITUDE.

options: B) What makes a location unique (physical + human characteristics)
questions.correct_answer: B) What makes a location unique (physical + human characteristics)
questions.explanation: PLACE describes the unique characteristics (physical and human) that make a location distinctive.

questions.text: Ethiopia's socio-cultural diversity is partly due to its:
options: B) Location as crossroads of Africa and Middle East
questions.correct_answer: B) Location as crossroads of Africa and Middle East
questions.explanation: Ethiopia's strategic location between Africa and Middle East brought diverse peoples, religions, and cultures.

options: B) Climate, landforms, and natural features
questions.correct_answer: B) Climate, landforms, and natural features
questions.explanation: Physical Geography focuses on NATURAL features (climate, landforms, soils, vegetation).

options: B) Population, culture, and human activities
questions.correct_answer: B) Population, culture, and human activities
questions.explanation: Human Geography focuses on HUMAN aspects: population, culture, economy, settlements.

questions.text: The 'REGION' theme groups areas based on:
questions.explanation: Regions group areas with common traits (e.g., highlands, agricultural areas, cultural regions).

questions.text: Ethiopia's location near the Red Sea gives it:
questions.explanation: Proximity to Red Sea trade routes gives Ethiopia geopolitical significance.
1,100,000 km² = 1.1 million square kilometers.

questions.text: The five themes of Geography were developed to help:
questions.explanation: The five themes organize how geographers study the world.
Absolute location gives EXACT coordinates (latitude + longitude).

options: B) Position in relation to other places
questions.correct_answer: B) Position in relation to other places
questions.explanation: Relative location describes where a place is compared to others (e.g., Ethiopia is north of Kenya).

options: B) Tropical location and seasonal rainfall patterns
questions.correct_answer: B) Tropical location and seasonal rainfall patterns
questions.explanation: Tropical location gives warm temperatures; seasonal rainfall creates wet/dry seasons.
Location answers 'Where?' — both absolute (coordinates) and relative (in relation to others).

options: A) Kenya, Sudan, Somalia, Djibouti, Eritrea, South Sudan
questions.correct_answer: A) Kenya, Sudan, Somalia, Djibouti, Eritrea, South Sudan
questions.explanation: Ethiopia borders 6 countries: Eritrea (north), Djibouti and Somalia (east), Kenya (south), Sudan and South Sudan (west).
